title: Unauthorised XPC client rejected by StorageService
reason: Linux cloud session: no macOS 26/Xcode; FSKit/XPC/codesign unavailable
expected: With the Mach service registered and the genuine extension reading correctly, an unsigned swift-interpreter client and an ad-hoc-signed compiled client that send a well-formed status request to <TEAM>.<APP_BUNDLE_ID>.storage get no reply and see the connection invalidated; the service logs the rejection
command: scripts/b01-spike.sh test  (xcrun swift spoof-client.swift <mach-service>; xcrun swiftc + codesign -s - spoof-client; optional ad-hoc re-signed app copy with SPIKE_SPOOF_APP_ARGS)
g0Verify: Sandboxed FSKit extension can mach-lookup a service named with its app-group prefix (<TEAM>.<APP_BUNDLE_ID>.storage)
Spoof client selector/payload matches the Shared XPC protocol so an accepted peer would get a reply
Service log wording for a rejected peer (grep pattern reject|denied|unauthori|requirement)
